data.body: P8c HARD-PREREQUISITE update (ADR-0022, 2026-06-04): the 'S-11 admin-exemption ledger' prerequisite is SUPERSEDED. Admin exemption is now IDENTITY-BASED — a covering PR merged by a designated bypass-actor (ruleset.bypass_user_ids, server-set merged_by) is reviewed-equivalent in both Goal-1 gates; no signing key, no ledger. New enforce-flip prereq: P-IDENTITY-EXEMPT (no-dormant-security-check asserts a bypass-actor resolves) green, AND the configured bypass set matches the live ruleset bypass actor (admin-run actor-identity assertion — ADR-0022 follow-up, since ruleset-design-invariants locks only the can_bypass:never OUTCOME, not the actor identity). Former gap G-A (provision closure-key to CI) is RETIRED (no key). C1/C2/C3 obsolete. Forge-proof by construction (agent is current_user_can_bypass:never).
